title: Not as substantial as other Mepra designs. Hard corners on then ends.
text:
Not as substantial as other Mepra designs. Hard corners on then ends.. Sole is the third setting of flatware from Mepra that I am comparing and this one isn't quite as lovely as the Dolce Vita or Vintage designs have been. On its own, this flatware is very nice, especially when compared to the average, inexpensive mixed material stuff we all bought right out of college at wally world. Yet next to the other high quality, well made, 18/10 stainless forks & knives from Mepra there is a notable difference.

Each one of these pieces is lighter weight than the other designs and slightly smaller. The Sole pieces just don't feel as substantial. The look reminds me a bit of an arts & crafts style with the long carved lines and the finish is that beautiful, bright high shine. These have fared well in the dishwasher and are nice to eat breakfast with - the knife does a good job with a ham slice. However, the hard corners on the ends of each utensil can be a little...pokey as you eat, even the spoons will catch your wrist in a coffee cup.
